description: The same definitional paragraph appears on three sibling pages rather than being stated once and linked. authentication.md's second paragraph and authentication-overview.md's abstract are verbatim identical ('To access Couchbase Server, users must be authenticated. _Authentication_ is a process for identifying who is attempting to access a system.'), and usernames-and-passwords.md restates it reworded. Copy-paste, not paraphrase, so the three will drift independently.
